Tårnby is a Danish municipality whose local healthcare outcomes are tracked within the national clinical quality databases for cardiovascular health. Specifically, it is included in the 2022–2023 annual report for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2]. The municipality's data is utilized for localized quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system.

In the context of the AFDK report, Tårnby is evaluated across key clinical quality indicators. For Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulation therapy using data from DanStroke, Tårnby's performance metrics are detailed in the municipal breakdown [^src1]. Additionally, the municipality is evaluated under Indicator 6, which tracks the incidence of intracranial hemorrhage among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients using standardized data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) [^src2].
